name: Bench T-Spine Stretch
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench and place both elbows on top, palms together or holding a light dowel.
Sit your hips back toward your heels while keeping your arms on the bench.
Let your chest sink toward the floor until you feel a stretch through your upper back.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Return to the start and repeat.
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: A kneeling stretch that opens the upper back and shoulders by sitting your hips back while your arms rest on a bench.

safetyNotes: Move into a gentle stretch only; ease off if you feel pinching in the shoulders.
